description: Field Email helps teams create and send professional, personalized, compliant emails. Predefined templates enforce brand guidelines and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CAN-SPAM). Dynamic fields and reusable content fragments allow message personalization. Built-in engagement tracking (opens, clicks) provides interaction insights. Merge field syntax uses {!Object.Field} format (e.g., {!Account.Name}, {!Contact.Email}).
setup_steps: Create email templates with merge fields using {!Object.Field} syntax
Configure reusable content fragments
Set up territory-based template assignments via TerritoryContentTmplAsgnt junction object
Configure sender email addresses using SenderEmailFieldApiName (not default Sender Type)
Enable engagement tracking
Set up Edit Subject Line flag for subject flexibility
gotchas: Use SenderEmailFieldApiName for custom sender addresses, NOT default Sender Type option
Email Queue does NOT respect SenderEmailFieldApiName - FROM address reflects logged-in user instead of configured field
BCC is NOT supported in Send Email functionality
No built-in email open/click tracking on the email template object - requires third-party integration
Custom picklist fields on email template do NOT surface as filter options in Send Email picker
Edit Subject Line flag combined with org-level AllowEditSubject shows predefined options PLUS free-text Other option - cannot show predefined without Other
migration_relevance: Veeva Approved_Email maps to EmailTemplate. Veeva tokens (ISILink, PILink, PieceLink) have NO direct equivalent - must create custom fields/objects for regulatory document URLs. Veeva {{token}} syntax maps to {!Object.Field} syntax.

description: Email templates have a dedicated junction object (TerritoryContentTmplAsgnt) for territory assignments. CLM Presentations do NOT have an equivalent assignment object. This asymmetry makes territory-based presentation querying harder compared to email templates. Custom territory-presentation junction objects may be needed for parity.
setup_steps: Create territory-template assignment records
Configure territory-based template filtering
Understand the asymmetry: presentations lack this junction object
gotchas: Presentations do NOT have an equivalent territory assignment junction object
This asymmetry affects reporting and territory-based content filtering
Custom junction objects may be needed for territory-presentation assignments
migration_relevance: Veeva territory-email mapping maps directly. Veeva territory-CLM mapping requires custom solution on the target platform.

description: Intelligent Content helps teams deliver relevant content during HCP interactions. Presentations use a many-to-many relationship with territories for content scoping. PresentationContent is part of Stories feature (AI-generated content) and has NO relationship to the CLM Presentation object. iOS content accordion has no tier that performs account-targeted fetch, causing iOS and Web to show different presentation lists for the same user/account.
setup_steps: Configure CLM Presentation objects
Set up Presentation Page Product links to connect content to products
Configure territory-presentation alignment
Set up content restriction mode behavior
Configure PPTX-to-HTML5 conversion for offline mobile consumption
gotchas: PresentationContent (Stories) is NOT related to CLM Presentation object - they share no relationship
iOS and Web show DIFFERENT presentation lists due to missing account-targeted fetch on iOS
Standalone video is NOT a supported content type for CLM - must embed in HTML presentations (ZIP packages)
Videos up to 8GB exist in customer environments - consider sync time and storage impact
In Restriction mode, web applies hard client-side gate but iOS only applies optional narrow-filter
Presentation Page Product is the standard object for linking presentation content to products
migration_relevance: Veeva CLM maps to Presentation/Intelligent Content. Veeva Media object maps to embedded content in HTML5 packages. Key Messaging maps to presentation slide tracking.

description: Event Management supports planning, managing, and closing regulated events (speaker programs, HCP meetings, sponsorship activities). Configurable workflows validate HCP eligibility, enforce subject and spending rules, and capture compliance acknowledgments. Event lifecycle covers creation, participant coordination, topic assignment, resource management, expense tracking, and closeout.
setup_steps: Configure event types and record types
Set up HCP eligibility validation rules
Configure spending rules and limits
Set up compliance acknowledgment capture
Configure event closeout workflows
Enable expense tracking and reporting
gotchas: HCP eligibility must be validated before event participation is confirmed
Spending rules must be enforced during event lifecycle, not just at closeout
Compliance acknowledgments must be captured before event progression
migration_relevance: Veeva Events Management maps to Event Management. Speaker program tracking, spend tracking, and compliance workflows have platform equivalents but configuration differs.

description: General Events help users schedule and track non-customer activities (internal meetings, team activities, training). Uses the standard Event object for calendar entries. The Planner shows general events alongside customer visits. Employees can be added to General Events for coordination. When logging internal activities like Quarterly Sales Training, the standard Event object with appropriate record type should be used.
setup_steps: Configure General Event record types on the standard Event object
Set up event calendar display in Planner
Configure employee attendee capabilities
Separate general events from customer engagement events in reporting
gotchas: General Events use the standard Event object, NOT a custom object
Calendar configuration represents General Event entries using standard Event
Must differentiate general events from customer engagement events for analytics
migration_relevance: Veeva general call types map to General Event record types on the standard Event object.

description: Surveys enable structured feedback collection. Support consistent data collection, regulatory requirements, and actionable insights. Mobile app supports offline surveys - responses collected offline are automatically synchronized when connectivity is restored. Surveys can be loaded by developer name and rendered on presentation UI. Response records sync when connectivity is available.
setup_steps: Create survey forms with appropriate question types
Configure survey invitations and distribution
Enable offline survey capability for mobile
Set up survey response analytics
Configure survey integration with presentation UI
gotchas: Offline survey responses sync automatically when connectivity restores
Survey developer names must be unique and properly configured for presentation integration
Response records may have a sync delay in offline scenarios
migration_relevance: Veeva Survey_vod maps to Survey. Offline survey capability is similar but sync behavior differs.

description: Field Insights transforms complex HCP and account information into concise actionable briefings before visits. Role-tailored insights help preparation. Insights can be converted to daily audio briefings as podcasts through the mobile app. Supports offline playback, playback continuity, and background playback for on-the-go consumption.
setup_steps: Configure Field Insights data sources
Set up role-based insight filtering
Enable audio briefing generation
Configure offline and background playback settings
gotchas: Audio briefings require platform AI licenses
Offline playback must be configured for mobile users
Background playback continues when users navigate away from the app
migration_relevance: No direct Veeva equivalent - Field Insights and audio briefings are net-new AI capabilities.

description: App Alerts provide timely notifications about updates, events, recommendations, and required actions. Generated by admins/managers, triggered by system, or provided through external recommendations. Users can respond directly, take recommended action, or dismiss with feedback. Centralized real-time communication channel across the application.
setup_steps: Configure alert types and triggers
Set up admin/manager alert creation workflows
Configure system-triggered alert rules
Enable external recommendation alert integration
Set up alert dismissal and feedback capture
gotchas: Alert dismissal feedback should be captured for improvement
System-triggered alerts need proper rule configuration to avoid alert fatigue
migration_relevance: Maps partially to Veeva alerts but with more sophisticated triggering and feedback capabilities.

description: Order Management combines store assessment, quoting, and pricing in a single workflow. Store Check shows products available/relevant at a location. Quoting uses price books, pricing rules, and transaction types. Field reps can evaluate a retail location and create a priced order during the same visit, moving seamlessly from store check to order creation.
setup_steps: Configure price books and pricing rules
Set up Store Check templates
Configure quoting workflow integration with visits
Enable transaction type configuration
gotchas: Store Check and order creation must be on the same visit for seamless workflow
Pricing rules and transaction types interact - test thoroughly
Account and visit must be connected for the full workflow
migration_relevance: Veeva Order_vod maps to Order. Store Check is a newer capability specific to retail/consumer goods scenarios within life sciences.
